enchantments.tooltip: Intelligence +14: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Good Luck +5: This item gives a +5 Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks.
Spell Absorption: This effect absorbs harmful spells targeted at the wearer.

Legendary Saltmarsh Explorer: 5 Pieces Equipped:+30 Artifact bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Rating+15 Artifact bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power+3 Artifact bonus to all Ability Scores+30 Artifact Bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
